name: Bauxitornis
sum: Large avisaurid enantiornithean from the Santonian Csehbánya Formation of Hungary known from one foot bone.
holotype: MTM V 2009.31.1 (formerly MTM Gyn/439), a right tarsometatarsus 51 mm long.
biology: Not given in the sources used beyond its size, similar to Soroavisaurus and Avisaurus.
author: Dyke and Osi 2010
